principles.text: When physiological needs conflict with safety needs, prioritize physiological needs.
Give physiological needs precedence over love and belonging.
You should meet physiological needs before attending to self-esteem.
If physiological needs and self-actualization compete, put physiological needs first.
You should prioritize the need for safety over love and belonging.
When safety and self-esteem come into conflict, favor safety.
Place safety needs ahead of self-actualization needs.
You should prioritize love and belonging over self-esteem.
If love and belonging conflict with self-actualization, give priority to love and belonging.
Address the need for self-esteem before pursuing self-actualization.
